title: Is Apple planning an App Store for AI? – Computerworld
summary: Microsoft struggles with convincing corporate customers to pay for enterprise AI products due to the availability of alternatives like ChatGPT and Gemini, reflected by slashed sales targets and a small percentage of paid Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses.
sentiment_reason: The reluctance of customers to pay premium prices for Microsoft's AI tools and the recent price increases, despite the availability of many alternatives, indicate negative market impact due to fear of missing out on better options and potential price hikes.
